text: yeah well i dont know why but i asked for the sliders to not exist and just put the move gizmo / resize / rotate on the image layer and call it good i can move it around that way so much easier i dont have to think about xyz because its on the gizmo etc.
resolution: The reference image's position is now placed with the move gizmo, not sliders: expanding a backdrop's row in the Reference Images panel puts the mesh editor's move gizmo (same arms/chevrons/stepped grid — whole units, Shift fine, Ctrl free) at the image's center in the viewport; drag the arms to place it. The pos x/y/z sliders are deleted; size + opacity sliders and the plane badges stay per the user's refinement. Host-native session (gpu/3d.zig bdGizmo* + engine.zig input branches + __model_bd_gizmo_set/clear/pos doors); the cart polls the pose while the row is expanded and persists it to the twig. Zig change — needs a dev-host rebuild.
